title: MultEval: Supporting Collaborative Alignment for LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation Criteria
reasoning: The paper focuses on a multi-user web-based system (MultEval) for the collaborative creation of evaluation criteria for LLM-as-a-judge frameworks. While it mentions values and normative preferences as categories for diagnosing human disagreement, it does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, moral frameworks, or ethical systems in LLMs.
